title: Law to set privacy and disclosure rules for AI chatbots
summary: This bill would require companies offering chatbots in New York City to secure user data, let users access their own chat logs and disclose clearly that they are talking to a bot rather than a person. It would bar chatbots from using personal data for ads or profiling without consent, prohibit claiming chatbot advice equals that of a licensed professional and require monthly safety risk assessments. Violations could bring civil penalties up to $25,000 and the law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
